## Goal
Add plugin hook discovery and validation for hooks/*.js modules under installed and enabled plugin roots.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R3 acceptance is covered for valid factory hook modules.
- Invalid factory shape, class shape, command metadata, hook metadata, and priority values are rejected.
- prepare.pre is rejected with a hard validation failure.

## Implementation Notes
Expose FLOW_COMMANDS, FLOW_COMMAND_HOOKS, and FlowCommandHook through the public api object passed to register(api). Do not require manifest hook contributions.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local contract tests with valid and invalid hook fixtures.
